turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Your past-due amount is $350.00.

turns.speaker: borrower
turns.text: I'll pay $100 this Friday and the rest next month.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you, $100 this Friday to start.

turns.speaker: borrower
turns.text: I'll pay $220 on Tuesday.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you, $220 on Tuesday.

turns.speaker: borrower
turns.text: Hmm, no, make it Wednesday. My paycheck lands that morning.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: No problem, $220 on Wednesday.

turns.speaker: borrower
turns.text: What's your late fee? I'm just asking, I'm not paying today.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: The late fee is $25.00 per missed payment.

turns.speaker: borrower
turns.text: Okay. Thanks.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: What amount could you commit to?

turns.speaker: borrower
turns.text: Three hundred and twenty-five dollars on November twentieth.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you, that's recorded.

turns.speaker: borrower
turns.text: I won't be able to pay the $200 on Friday like I said before.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks for letting us know. Is there another date that works?

turns.speaker: borrower
turns.text: Not right now, sorry.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Can we schedule a payment toward the $420.00 past due?

turns.speaker: borrower
turns.text: I'll pay 140 next Monday.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you, $140 next Monday.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: How much could you pay this week?

turns.speaker: borrower
turns.text: I'm not sure of the amount, but I'll pay what I can on Friday.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you, we'll look for your payment Friday.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Your account shows $410.00 past due.

turns.speaker: borrower
turns.text: I'm sending $410 on Dec 3.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you, $410 on December 3.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: What could you afford?

turns.speaker: borrower
turns.text: I make $900 every two weeks. I'll pay $150 on the 25th.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you, $150 on November 25.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Your past-due amount is $275.00. Can you make a payment?

turns.speaker: borrower
turns.text: My hours got cut. I need a hardship plan, I can't commit to anything.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'll connect you with our hardship team.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: When could you make your next payment?

turns.speaker: borrower
turns.text: I'll pay 175 a week from today.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you, $175 one week from today.
